items.title: Trump says retaining Russia in G8 might have prevented Ukraine war
items.summary: US President Donald Trump argued that keeping Russia in the G8 could have prevented the conflict in Ukraine. He also described the former eight-member format as stronger than the current G7.

items.title: Trump says Putin would be welcome at US-hosted G20 summit
items.summary: President Donald Trump said Russian President Vladimir Putin would be welcome to attend the G20 summit in the United States if he wished to participate.

items.title: Latvia issues possible air threat warning in eastern district
items.summary: Latvia's armed forces announced that residents of the eastern Ludza district had been sent a warning about a possible aerial threat. The origin of the threat was not specified in the announcement.

items.title: Russian governor reports drone interceptions in Leningrad region
items.summary: The governor of Russia's Leningrad region reported that four drones had been intercepted over the region.
